notes: Three taḥwīl branches meet at Shuʿba. «كلهم عن شعبة» joins the first two; the third writes «حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة» (occurrence 2). The tail («عن قتادة، عن أنس، عن عبادة») is written once after the last taḥwīl and belongs to all three.
«وأبو داود» after «محمد بن جعفر» is not placed as a route: the text does not say whom he heard. Left out, noted.
«أبي» is the father of Ubayd Allah ibn Muʿadh, named only by relation.
